:::{#def-quadratic-program}
#### Quadratic program (quadratic programming problem)

A **quadratic program**, or **quadratic programming problem**,
[@wikipedia_quadratic_programming]
is a [minimization problem](#def-minimization-problem) whose [objective](#def-objective-function) is

$$f(\vx) = \tfrac{1}{2}\,\qform{\matr{S}}{\vx} + \tp{\vecf{c}} \vx,$$

for a $p \times p$ [positive semidefinite matrix](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-positive-semidefinite) $\matr{S}$
and a vector $\vecf{c} \in \reals^p$,
and whose [constraints](#def-constraints) are linear equations and linear [inequalities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-inequality) in $\vx$.

:::
